limitations: Manufacturer nominal AMSO family dimensions; exact power/revision suffix unresolved. Local dimensions and hidden mechanisms are inferred.
Source people, food, titles, wipes and fades omitted under approved microwave structure, visible mechanics and camera scope.

Small graphics and display font shapes approximate source. Two live scenes crop the far-right knob and are matched by remaining consistent geometry.
Native manifold/recess and sampled outer-door clearance checks do not constitute dynamic force, safety-interlock or contact validation.
